reviews.text: Initial take. Nonsense
Best Yoga Nidra!. I have LOVE to this app, I use it all the time. The cadence of the guidance is really ideal. I highly recommend it, I like it much more than other yoga nidra apps I’ve tried.

Awesome!!. This has been one of the best apps on my phone. I use it all the time just for a quick refresher or deeper rest constantly.. There have been days when I haven't been able to sleep ALL NIGHT.. seriously. I've played this (30 min version) back to back 4 times and felt so deeply rested that I was able to do my day feeling wonderful.. I share it with everyone who could use it. As a massage therapist I've recommended it to countless new friends and clients... Thanks for such a great app
❤️🙏❤️
Great app. Highly recommend. After trying several yoga nidra apps and podcasts, I’m very happy to have found this one. Thanks!

SCAM!. Are you kidding me?? This is one track of audio that can be 10, 20 or 30 mins long. That’s it. It’s the same track every time. One single walk-through of telling you to relax different parts of your body. That’s all. Complete rip-off.
Yoga Nidra. This is a fabulous yoga nidra meditation
Script won’t play. Doesn’t work.

Changed my mind.. The first time I used it I didn’t realize there were choices in the length of the practice and the default was ten minutes. Ten minutes is a completely inadequate time span for yoga Indra so I was really annoyed that I bought the app. When I decided to check in the settings and found there was a proper 30 minute practice I tried it again. It’s really a lovely and effective practice and much needed on stressful work days.
Best yoga Indra app ever. This is simply the best relaxation app ever
simple and perfect!. i tried a lot of ways to meditate. only yoga Nidra is nice ok to me.

Effective. I’ve taken yoga Nidra classes and this is authentic. The voice is very soothing. You have the options of adding nature sounds to the voice over. There’s 3 meditations of varies lengths. Yoga Nidra is especially helpful if you have insomnia.
Sublime. This is a beautifully guided Yoga Nidra practice. Highly recommended. 🙏🏽🙏🏽🙏🏽
Soothing voice - incredible experience. This is the next best thing to experiencing yoga nidra in a class. Highly recommended.
Everyone should use. Very beneficial for reducing stress!
Crashes on iOS. I love this app but it freezes up constantly

Daily practice. I am practicing yoga nidra as part of a sadhana. So far, this my favorite app for the practice. The teacher’s voice is steady and soothing. The directions are clear and easy to follow. The result over the last few days has been a very relaxing experience. I will definitely recommend this app to friends and fellow yoga practitioners.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS APP. I’ve been using it for four years now, especially during times of severe insomnia.
Thirty minutes of yoga nidra really does help me feel like I got a fuller night of sleep. Though it’s not the same as getting 6-8 hours, using this app gives me much needed benefits during those times. My stress levels remain low. I’m able to stay focused and a lot more energized throughout the day. Plus it’s great way to sneak in a meditation practice.
I tell people about this app all the time, especially if they don’t have time to take a nap or unable to (like myself).
Wonderful. I love this app. I love you can change the length. Perfect for a pick me up, for stress relief or for travel.
Very flexible. I like that you can customize the duration and background noise. Leander’s voice is soothing.

Exceptional. I have been practicing yoga for many years and have sought out countless methods of meditation. This is app is the best meditation I have ever experienced and it is affecting my ability to sleep in ways I had always hoped for. In addition, the positive affirmations combined with the relaxation technique has certainly changed my ability to care for myself and to live in more encouraging ways with others. I feel as if I operate in my own “space” and better understand myself as separate from others. I would highly recommend this app for anyone struggling with relaxation, sleep, depression or anxiety.

A grandmothers peace. I absolutely love this app. I use it almost daily after babysitting my grand babies. Better than a nap, it always takes me mentally to a relaxed peaceful state. I practice yoga twice a week, this app has helped me know how to take my mind to that place of comfort as well.
I have several other nidra apps. However I love your pace and voice. 

Thank you so much🙏🏼NAMASTE
Use it almost everyday.. Sometimes we use it to fall asleep at night even though you’re not supposed to sleep during it 😬
Nice app. Easy to follow along with the script. Does just what it says it will do-helps you get to a nice meditative state.

Like NyQuil for anxiety sufferers. Thank you yoga nidra for helping me quiet my mind, focus on breath and focus on rest. Bouts of anxiety and sleeplessness have been overcome nearly immediately with this app. It is the real deal.

One Meditation. When I purchased this app I expected to have for my use more than just one meditation. There are three different times such as 10 minutes, 15 minutes and 30 minutes but only one meditation. The 30 minute one that I used was good. I just wish I had more options as far as the variety as well as an option for a one hour meditation.

Overall, For the price it's good.

Not worth it. There is only one 10 min guided session in the whole app - that was a rip off especially when there are other free ones with 100s of sessions! Don't buy this. I gave it two star because the session itself was fine - just false advertising.
Great Meditation Tool. This app has really made a difference in my meditation practice.
The best yoga nidra. I've used over a dozen yoga nidra sequences. This is the best one of them all. Teacher is clear, straightforward practice, and customizable. Love this app and use it regularly.
This app is the business.. I use it all if the time. I know you're not supposed to sleep but it is the best for a quick power nap 😴
Excellent app!. This is the best yoga nidra app I have found. Excellent!

Good stuff. Like iced tea on a hot day

awesome awesome awesome

I am a clinical psychotherapist and an adhd/ add coach and have used this app for about four years

My doc recommended this app for insomnia. This app has changed my ability to fall asleep and I'm so thankful. I have been struggling with insomnia and the sleep hygiene tips were not working. I certainly was not interested in medication. My doc said one of her patients told her about this app and I could give it a shot. So glad she told me - I now fall asleep before in less than 5 minutes! His voice is so soothing and the directions clear.

Confusing description. While the 10 minute session is quite nice, the ad copy sounded like the app also included a 20 minute and a 30 minute session. That it's not the case. Only the 10 minute is included. Feeling a little ripped off.
Absolutely love it!. It was my first experience of meditation, I still say it's one of my favorites. I have recommended it to my friends and they love it too!

Yoga nidra! Love it!. I have been using this app for several weeks now and I can't tell you how much more focused and relaxed I am. I highly recommend it for anyone who needs to put some peace back into their stressful life.
Great app. Highly recommend it!

Gooooood!. Works well for me. I sleep well. My aches and pains improve when I do this.

I give to all my patients for basic stress relief and yoga on the go. Simple easy guided relaxation.
Great app. The speaker's voice is so calming and the music truly peaceful. You will awaken feeling refreshed and full of positive energy!
Very relaxing. I use this app almost every night. It's very user friendly and effective. Highly recommended!

Essential!. Can't say enough good things about this app! Whether you need a guided meditation to relax into sleep or recharge your mind/body...this one is it! Well worth the investment in the paid version, though the free one is also excellent.
Very helpful for falling asleep.. This is a great app.
Great App - Keeps things simple. I've tried a number of meditation/relaxation apps but I keep coming back to this one. Simple to use. Low cost. And, easy customization for my personal tastes.

Yoga Nidra Deep Relaxation Practice. Outstanding guided meditation with attention focused,as one would expect in a yogic meditative practice, on the body & it's sensations.
Voice of the guide is authoritative, yet calming, perfectly hypnotic, yet respectful & encouraging of the practitioner's capacities. 
I have 77 years of hyper, anxious, driven character structure, but with some life practice of yoga & meditation at a low intermediate level.
I have tried numerous meditative apps and methods -- this is the most powerful one I have come across.
Excellent. I use the short program to help fall asleep and relax. It's been life changing.
Great Yoga Nidra app. App works great. Lots of options to customize your experience (time, sound, etc.). Highly recommend.
Very soothing. I used it often to relax and regain energy.

So good!. I highly recommend this app! I love nidra and it is such a great way to have access to it whenever i want. I do it daily. I only wish there was an option to help you fall asleep that didn't encourage you to stay awake or wake you up at the end. Please make one like that.
Perfect before bed:). Love the cues and the results- bliss...

yes, worth it.. love it. soothing voice and the length of the meditation (although short for a nidra practice) really helps with building a regular meditation practice. highly recommended (esp for beginners) and i've gone through a good amount of online nidra recordings. love having the accessibility of this yoga nidra practice on my phone.
Works for me. I use it when I wake up during the night and can't get back to sleep. I've tried many programs with music or sounds, but this is working very well for me.
Exactly what I needed.. This app is incredibly accessible to the beginner. Very simple and functional. Soothing voice, exactly what I needed.
Great app!. I really feel relaxed after meditating with this app.
Love love love!. So helpful for relaxation!
This has become my go-to for meditation!. I rely have found the meditations productive and relaxing. I have tried many meditation apps and this is on the top of my list!

Lovely. I usually never bother with reviews but I had to make an exception for this app. Of all the yoga nidra apps, I love this one the best. The narrator has a soothing voice and the background sounds are a nice touch! 

My problem is that sometimes I get TOO relaxed and fall asleep. (Obviously not the app's or narrator's fault.). 

Other than that, perfect.
👍. Really nice for my early morning yoga
Excellent meditation. Best one I have found for I Phone.. Thank you. I use it daily.
Love it!. Great version of yoga nidra. I love it and try to do it every day. One of my favorite meditation tools. Highly recommend.

Replacing Ambien. I've been withdrawing from Ambien and this is the greatest aid I have found. Even upon waking too early yoga nidra is a great way to spend the remaining time in bed and completing the rest and relaxation cycle. The positive affirmation aspect of yoga Nidra also seems to be effective. Thanks to the developers.
Excellent!. Exactly what I was looking for after having a personal yoga teacher do yoga nidra with me. This is just as good!
Best relaxation tool ever!. The thirty minute version is best. Guides me right into a lucid dream state every time.
It's great for relaxing. It's great for relaxing
Yoga nidra. I listen to this every night before going to sleep and it is so relaxing. I love the choice of using nature sounds and the differently lengths. It's wonderful.

A favorite for relaxation. I really love this app. I have a number of sleep/relaxation apps and this one is an absolute favorite. 
I enjoy the practice of yoga and meditation. This app has beautiful music which can be switched off if desired and a very calming voice to guide you through your practice of Yoga Nidra.
I highly recommend this app as an excellent relaxation tool. 
Namaste
Best app. Fantastic app

Able to turn off loud music!. I am changing my review from negative to positive because I discovered that one can now turn off the intrusively loud music/gong sound. While the music is quite beautiful, it was too disrupting. This should be added to the instructions, or the speaker icon should be appropriately labeled. Note To Users: In the upper right corner of the opening app screen, use the grayish speaker icon to turn off the music ONLY for your meditation session. Also, the gong rings in the beginning, but will NOT sound once the voice/session has ended. Thanks for this update! Suggestion: The meditation can be enhanced if one could allow the nature sounds to continue on after the voice has ended.
Always does the trick. This versatile app gives you plenty of options. 10, 20, or 30 minutes and a variety of soothing background sounds. I always get up refreshed and centered.
Love this app!. Really good sounds and calming voices.
Superb rest!. Whether 10, 20 or 30 minutes, it's a great app to have for a moment when you just need to get away!

Do it. This is app is truly exquisite! As an experienced practitioner and facilitator of yoga nidra, I deeply enjoy this simple method of accessing deep relaxation, with options that suit my busy schedule. His voice is amazing, the sequencing is well-researched and perfectly timed. The world would quickly become a better place if all iPhone users utilized this simple tool.
Aop. Excellent app.
Yoganidra. Love this app! Great for all level practioners. Very handy, can be done anywhere anytime.

Helps me relax and be present. I love the options available with this app and I love his voice. I only wish I knew what the first and final words mean. I really appreciate this app!!! Helps me keep centered and relax even in the midst of craziness with two little boys in my life.

Please fix!!. I LOVE this Yoga Nidra practice but since it has been upgraded to the 1.3 version the app shuts down when my phone auto-locks and I have to unlock the phone to get back into it...not very relaxing. The previous version did not do this...PLEASE fix this so I can continue to enjoy my Nidra :-)

Great app but intrusive music!!. Love the content and delivery of this app, but after purchasing the full version, I am back to using the lite 10 minute version because it does not have the loud, intrusive music at the end. The music disrupts any calmness or centeredness created by completing the program, and interrupts my stillness when I have to open my eyes and fumble with my iPhone to turn it off. Please add the option of removing the music from the sequence, or I cannot wholeheartedly recommend this app.
yoga meditation. Unfortunately the sound quality is less than optimal.

Great nidra. The app is wonderful. I usually do para yoga nidra and this one is similar only shorter My only complaint is that there is not an hour long option. The voice and guidance is right on. I Agee that the music is a bit intrusive. But as soon as you start the program ( by pressing the arrow in the middle of the screed) the music subsides and then it is only voice and sounds as you choose.
Yoga Nidra. I have searched for a meditation practice, and this one has been easy to add to my life.

Excellent practice. I like having the choice of practice length, as some days I have less time to practice. I do think he moves a bit too quickly through the body scan - more so than other Yoga Nidra practices I have tried. But all in all it is an excellent program, and I love the intro music. I find it very relaxing to come back to the present with that music.

I love this app. I have heard other versions of yoga nidra but this is the best. The three options - 10, 20, and 30 minutes - have helped me to fit it into my day more regularly. I wish I could get it on my iPod too.
Favorite meditation app. Well executed, seamless, and reliable app!

Wonderful!. I have been wanting to try Yoga Nidra, so was excited to see it as an app. I love this app! The voice is beautiful and relaxing! Very easy to use! Has everything you need.It is strange how it works, but it does. Even if I am so tired that I fall asleep.. when I do this Yoga Nidra I wake feeling refreshed! It really does work! I highly recommend this app!
Please stop the music. As soon as you launch the app it starts playing music with is very annoying and there's no way to opt out of it. I haven't actually tried the practice yet.

5 years Use 2-3 times a week. Great addition for deep relaxation and sleep. I know you’re not meant to - but dos the trick.
Also to recharge batteries
Simple but spot on. Great, simple app with extra information within. I’ve used it for several years now - and still my favourite.

Love!. I downloaded this years ago and found it so beneficial, then fell out of the habit of using it. I’ve picked it back up more recently and am cross with myself for not using it consistently. Ten minutes a day makes such a difference to my anxiety and physical symptoms of chronic illness. I highly recommend this app.
So relaxing! Used this for years!. I use this to help chronic pain, particularly great in the car ( not driving!) on the train and any time you need to chill out. Brilliant!
Brilliant app. Wonderful meditation

Little dorrit. I absolutely this app, 
Have recommended it to many people who suffer from stress and anxiety , it’s been a good starting block for them , and had very good feed back .

Best Yoga Nidra App. This is by far the best Yoga Nidra meditation available. The voice is calming and clear. I use this all the time. The only thing I would like is for some longer periods of silence in between instructions
My secret weapon!. Been using this app for years. It’s the best. Makes me more centred and stronger any day I do it. Have recommended to many friends who love it too.
Jenny D. This app is brilliant. I tried the free one first but upgraded to this version shortly afterwards. The voice is soothing, choice of length good and is overall a very useful tool.
Doesn’t play. Both free and paid-for app don’t play the track - rubbish.
So relaxing. Wonderful! I use this all the time. So incredibly relaxing. I’d give it an extra star if I could! Highly recommended for times of physical or psychological stress.
Great App. Simple to use and does what it says on the tin. I use it every day to meditate.
Love using this app!. Easy to use and a great tool for relaxation.
Perfectly simple. This app is worth the reasonable price as you can trawl through free stuff forever and never find this quality. It’s not too fluffy or wordy. It’s simple yet very deep. Delighted

Wonderful. This practice is a rare gem. It can support lucid dreaming, it can substitute hours of sleep, and it can heighten your awareness to boost personal development in all areas. And it really, really relaxes. Try and see, only do stay awake! The app didn’t invent the idea of course- this ‘technology’ has been around quite a while! But the guidance is sweet and simple and is put together nicely with easy options for 10, 20 and 30 min sessions so you can tailor it both to your skill at staying awake and time available. Personally I try to mix up yoga nidra with audio guidance from other places, just because a fresh voice can help prevent falling asleep and that’s the central challenge in this practice.

Great app. This is a very simple app with three choices as to length of session. It’s great, the man has a lovely, and calm, voice that guides you through the session confidently. I also use other online Yoga Nidra sessions, to ring the changes a little, but keep coming back to this one

Nothing to this app. This app is just music. There is nothing about guiding through different nidra positions. There is nothing in this app over and above Yoga nidra videos you can get for free on YouTube. Total waste of money and can only suggest that the other reviews of this app are fake.

Great. I tried the free version first then quickly bought the full version, great value. I love the background noise of rain you can use. Fab whenever but also as a method to go to sleep. The voice is pleasant and not intrusive, all good.
Love it. I suffer with fibromyalgia and CFS this app has helped me gain some control over my pain levels and help my muscles relax. I would highly recommend it
Effective deep relaxation. This is the best app for deep relaxation. I truly believe that a session is equivalent to a long deep sleep.
Mrs A Stevens. Love this app...been using for a few years now..extremely relaxing

Yoga nidra. Just wonderful. 
Has helped me to deal with hypertension without pills!

Yoga for the stressed. Really effective app, feel fantastic if I'm carrying out the practice and wake up fresh in the morning though don't always manage to get through the whole 30 minutes without falling to sleep!
His voice is really easy to listen to and having the same format for the 10,20 or 30 minute practice works really well, with increasing detail in the longer sessions. This enables you to start small with an effective outcome and move to the half an hour where you can be more immersed.

Brilliant App!. I've used this for over a year now and think it's fab! It's flexible so you can pick a 10, 20 or 30 minute session and really focuses you in. He has a very soft gentle voice. I always feel relaxed afterwards. Highly recommend!
Beautiful. This is a really lovely yoga nidra. So soothing and calming and never fails to help me feel relaxed.
Very good. I use this app a lot. Great guided meditation/body scan . Imagery used is very relaxing and empowering. The guides voice feels just perfect . Would highly recommend.

Great app!. I have found this to be a great app! The price is great and I have used it consistently for about six months.
As part of a relaxation practice , this app has helped me to be able to fall asleep more easily at night. I have used it during lunch time laid on my office floor and found it has recharged my batteries, it has also helped remind me what I am here on the planet to do. 
As part of a meditation practice, I have found that using this app twice a day has reinforced my mission, has helped me to see my defences and delusions and allowed me to make wiser decisions of a more compassionate nature.
I think this app would help anyone who is over busy with lots going on in their head, anyone who has a lot of time on their hands and would like to learn something new, mothers who need a little me time. I have found shouting "just doing yoga nidra" and the little voices just vanish! Amazing! Also dogs who like a bit of lie on the floor time with their person and cats who like to watch what the humans do also benefit from that bit of special time with their favourite relaxed human.
Enjoy this app and enjoy the benefits in your life!

Perfect! So relaxing.. I downloaded a whole host of relaxation apps when I was going through a stressful time at work. This is by far and away my favourite. Although the gong and the singing can by slightly off putting when you first open the app, don't worry! During the yoga nidra there's just a nice relaxing voice and the sound of rain.
I downloaded this about five months ago and I am still using this at bedtime. Great app!
Excellent app. Unfussy app - doesn't try to do too much but has a good combination of lengths of time, and options for background noise. A real staple.

Best relaxation/meditation app I've tried.... This one is simple and effective. If you prefer an app that just talks you through relaxation and mindfulness, without lots of "you are a wonderful unique person who can achieve anything" stuff over the top this is perfect. Plus the 'paid for' option offers three session lengths and sound options, which I found was plenty... Also, I found the voice used very soothing - it may seem obvious but some have terrible voice options...

So good!. I downloaded the free app and it was great but getting the full version is worth the small amount of money for the relaxation that it can bring you. If you want to learn to relax then is a great place to start, if you already can relax then this is just another beautiful way to achieve it.
Enjoy.
Zzzzzz. This is astonishing, I've never heard the end as I always fall asleep. So, great to nod off to but breaking every rule of yoga nidra because you are supposed to remain awake but relaxed!
Excellent. I've been really struggling to get to sleep and this has helped enormously. I feel more relaxed after doing it, even the ten minute one, than I thought was possible.
Perfect. Perfect, really works! Asleep minutes after the session :)
Perfect. Love it. First time I tried it I was asleep before the 10 minutes was up! Now I can listen and relax and only occasionally fall asleep.

Excellent App. Madhav's voice is pure, soothing and unpretentious. The nature sounds are unobtrusive and realistic. Yoga Nidra is a wonderful practice. I like the option of a 10, 20 or 30 minute session. Would like some more background information and guidance on creating an effective sankalpa. Highly recommended app.
Use this app every night. I love it! Puts me to sleep every time! Wish there wasn't a gong at the end of the practice.

So glad I found this app. I used to practise yoga nidra in Sweden years ago. It really help me with sleeping difficulties and made me more aware and how to deal with inner stress. It's the best thing I have ever learnt.
Great find!. Perfect to relax and recharge
Bliss. I practice Yoga Nidra on a daily basis and this script is one of my favourites.
The real thing. This is a beautiful pukka version of yoga nidra. With or without nature sounds.
Yoga Nidra. Amazing
Calms the mind. The guys voice is great, not at annoying which is unusual for this kind of thing. Very relaxing, I usually use it after a yoga practice and it is calming and restful.
Top marks. Superb app. Never fails to put me in a super relaxed state and clears my head.
A Lifesaver. It gives me rest and relaxation when most needed. Thank you.
Totem. Very good Voice, I listen once a day. You are to me so fulfillness. Shanty shanty shanty
My go to meditation app!. Excellent app for relaxation and reconnection.

Voix relaxante. J'aime beaucoup ce nidra, pas trop long, belle voix et musique de fond
Super
Used it once. I used this app once and loved it. Go to open it on day two and the sound will not work. I tried everything in my settings to trouble shoot this to no avail. Too bad, it had promise.

Insomnia relief. This is great to help falling asleep (even though It's not its first prepose)! I've had some pretty bad insomnia my hole life and this is definitely a big help. Also, one of the best meditations that I've found. ,)

Perfect relaxation. I use this guided relaxation as the final step in my exercise routine. I've had a delicate lower back for decades and even though I'm very careful I'll always have a bit of an ache there after exercise. After stretching I launch the Yoga Nidra app, put a pillow under my knees, and lie flat on my back to listen. The result is always the same, when I stand up the backache is gone.
Well done. I like this Yoga Nidra a lot. Wish there was a longer version tho
Great!. Very effective!

Yoga Nidra. Great app. Yoga Nidra is not just a wonderful relaxation tool, but a guided meditation which benefits other aspects of your life. 
This recording is very well done with options for length and background sounds. 
Perfect meditation for newbies or those more experienced.

Thanks. I loved it , haven't been sleeping cause too much in my mind . So I started to use this app . Best relaxation and after done I slept right threw the nite , before I would wake up 5 times a nite

Best app. I have been suffering from severe panic attacks and find the 30 minute sessions life saving. I highly recommend trying this everyday before the stress builds. Great preventive medicine for everyone!!!!
Wonderful app!!!. I am using this on a daily basis and find it so relaxing!
School Clinician. Excellent app for busy professional people who are stressed and always on the go...a great way to sneak a 10 minute stress break in or unwind before bed.

On line elementary teacher / yoga teacher. This app is nothing short of fabulous! The voice is calm and steady which helps the practitioner easily reach the relaxed borderline state between sleep and wakefulness.

Yoga Nidra - it really works. I have found this App so helpful for day rests, relaxing baths and times at night when I’m struggling with insomnia. It’s very effective in slowing me down and allowing me to relax all my muscles. Highly recommend to anyone looking to practice relaxation and rest.
Deep relaxation. Love the sound and the the way it was presented

Great meditation. After many years of practicing mindfulness and meditation, this particular one I return to regular as o e of my favourites. Soothing voice, great visualisation and relaxing nature sounds. Love the rain

Deep Gratitude. Hari Om. 
It is such a delight to have this gorgeous Satyananda Yoga Nidra app. I have a predisposition for stress/tension and not sleeping well and I found this app many years ago, even when I realised you fixed the left armpit because it bothered me that it was skipped and I would fixate on it. Haha! 
It was the only thing that helped me sleep well, almost guaranteed. I have had this app for so long now, but last year I went to my local Ashram (as linked in the Ajapa Japa app) where they practice Satyananda Yoga. I didn’t realise it at the time, until I was in my first Yoga Nidra session at the Ashram, that I knew the Sanskrit terminology and the routine. I was blown away. I have since learned more about the benefits of Yoga Nidra and Satyananda Yoga and why it’s important to do it every day. It truly is a mind, body, and spiritual reset and in today’s world and city living, so incredibly important. My deepest gratitude to you, Madhav, for sharing your training and experience with this part of the Satyananda philosophy and practice so that all may benefit! 🙏🏼🕉️

Also, love that you’re a fellow Australian. Your voice is very calming. 

Om 🕉️
Best meditation app ever. Love this meditation app. So simple and really effective. Thank you.
Very Good. Am very much enjoying this app now, but could do without the music at the start

Very beneficial. This app is amazing. I was suffering from intense nerve pain and unable to sleep. This app provided very deep rest and helped me to step outside of the physical pain. It played a key part in my recovery. I will definitely continue using it.

Excellent. I’ve been using this app for the last 5 years. It’s helped me through cancer treatment and beyond. I love the simplicity of the practice and I really do find so much peace and relaxation by using it often. Such a beautiful practice- thank you so much.
Great practice. This is a great practice done with a great practitioner highly recommended
Yoga Nidra. I love to absolutely love this app it has everything I need for a complete relaxation

Yoga Nidra. Over many years I have become a dedicated (daily) practitioner of Yoga Nidra.
This app is great!
 Although I use other guided yoga nidra practices this is one of the best. The balance between voice and ambient sound is beautiful. My preference is the rain/thunderstorm.
The introductory "gatha" is beautifully sung and sets the mind at ease, ready to follow the voice guiding the practice!
I have recommended this app to my friends.
It helps resolve mental tension and anxiety etc.etc. 
I can't recommend this app enough!
 To those who purchase it, please try and set aside time to practise daily the benefits more than outweigh the 10,20, 30 minutes practice time.

🙏🏻 Justyn
Best meditation app I’ve used. Easy to use, calming voice, easy technique to follow

Great app. My go to app around 3pm, when I need a reboot. 💕this app and highly recommend it....🙏🏼
Namaste

Sound levels are bad. This would be a good app if it was sound mixed properly. I might sound pedantic here, but when I’m lying down to meditate, i don’t want to be racing to turn sound levels up and down. The Indian chanting that is a ‘placeholder’ for the app is too loud. Then the actual instructions are really soft and almost drowned out by their background atmos music. Once the yoga Nidra is finished the chanting comes on automatically and is way too loud. Not exactly relaxing! If the sound levels are fixed I’d recommend it. As it is, nope.

Lifesaver. For the last three and half years, this has been part of my daily routine. Grateful for this app. Lifesaver during stressful periods.
